## IXP Extraction Models

The extraction models are configured at the **IXP project level** (the Document Understanding component behind your Maestro flow), via `uip ixp projects configure-model`. The CLI validates these names server-side:

| Model Key (use with `--model`) | Description |

## Optional: Intelligent Pre-processing Modes

When changing the extraction model you can also tune the pre-processing stage (affects table/structure handling):

| Mode | Use case |
|---|---|
| `none` | Plain text documents |
| `table_mini` | Light table detection |
| `table` | Full table/structured document extraction |

---

```bash
uip ixp projects configure-model vendor_invoices-3e19dd82-ixp \
  --model gemini_2_5_pro \
  --preprocessing table \
  --output json
```

The three extraction models (`gemini_2_5_flash`, `gemini_2_5_pro`, `gpt_4o_2024_05_13`) are the ones your Maestro flow can use. Currently it's running on `gemini_2_5_flash` (the `gemini_ixp` backend).
